# Schumacher-Knepper store guide

**English** · [Français](../fr/guide.md) · [Deutsch](../de/guide.md) · [Lëtzebuergesch](../lb/guide.md)

This guide explains how to manage the Schumacher-Knepper Shopify store. Shopify button names are kept in English so they match the screenshots.

## Contents

1. [Customizing the theme](#1-customizing-the-theme)
2. [Filters, collections and products](#2-filters-collections-and-products)
3. [Translations](#3-translations)

## 1. Customizing the theme

### Make a safe copy of the theme

**Step 1:** Click on **Online Store**.

![Click on Online Store.](../../screenshots/1-customization/1-click-on-online-store.png)

**Step 2:** Click on the three dots (**…**) next to the current theme.

![Click on the three dots (…) next to the current theme.](../../screenshots/1-customization/2-click-on-3-dots.png)

**Step 3:** Click on **Duplicate**. Always work on a copy so you don't break the live theme.

![Click on Duplicate. Always work on a copy so you don't break the live theme.](../../screenshots/1-customization/3-click-on-duplicate-to-avoid%20messing-up-the-main-theme.png)

**Step 4:** On the copy, click on **Edit theme**.

![On the copy, click on Edit theme.](../../screenshots/1-customization/4-click-on-edit-theme.png)

### Customize a page

**Step 5:** To customize a page, click on **Home page** at the top of the editor.

![To customize a page, click on Home page at the top of the editor.](../../screenshots/1-customization/5-to-customize-a-page-click-on-home-page.png)

**Step 6:** Select the page you want to edit.

![Select the page you want to edit.](../../screenshots/1-customization/6-click-on-the-wanted-page.png)

### Change the theme settings

**Step 7:** To change the theme settings, click on the gear button in the top-left corner.

![To change the theme settings, click on the gear button in the top-left corner.](../../screenshots/1-customization/7-to-customize-the-theme-settings-click-on-top-left-gear-button.png)

**Step 8:** To change the color schemes, click on **Colors**.

![To change the color schemes, click on Colors.](../../screenshots/1-customization/8-to-change-scheme-colors-click-on-colors.png)

**Step 9:** Change the colors in the panel on the right.

![Change the colors in the panel on the right.](../../screenshots/1-customization/9-then-change-colors-on-the-right-side.png)

### Save and publish

**Step 10:** Click on **Save** in the top-right corner. Don't skip this step.

![Click on Save in the top-right corner. Don't skip this step.](../../screenshots/1-customization/10-dont-forget-to-save-on-top-right.png)

**Step 11:** Click on **Exit** in the top-left corner.

![Click on Exit in the top-left corner.](../../screenshots/1-customization/11-exit-on-top-left.png)

**Step 12:** Click on **Publish** to make your copy the live theme.

![Click on Publish to make your copy the live theme.](../../screenshots/1-customization/12-click-on-publish.png)

## 2. Filters, collections and products

Store filters (for example *Volume*) come from **metaobjects**. To add a filter, you create a metaobject definition, add its entries, then register it as a filter in the **Search & Discovery** app.

### Create a metaobject definition

**Step 1:** Click on the gear icon in the bottom-left corner to open **Settings**.

![Click on the gear icon in the bottom-left corner to open Settings.](../../screenshots/2-filters/1-click-on-bottom-left-gear-icon-button-to-open-settings.png)

**Step 2:** Click on **Metafields and metaobjects**.

![Click on Metafields and metaobjects.](../../screenshots/2-filters/2-click-on-metafields-and-metaobjects.png)

**Step 3:** Under **Metaobjects**, click on **Add definition**.

![Under Metaobjects, click on Add definition.](../../screenshots/2-filters/3-click-on-add-definition-for-metaobjects.png)

**Step 4:** Name the definition in the plural (for example *Volumes*). Name the field in the singular (for example *Volume*) and choose the type **Single line text**.

![Name the definition in the plural (for example Volumes). Name the field in the singular (for example Volume) and choose the type Single line text.](../../screenshots/2-filters/4-name-in-plural-and-fields-in-singular-then-choose-single-line-text.png)

### Add entries (filter values)

**Step 5:** After saving, go back to the home page, click on **Content** and stay in **Metaobjects**. Choose the metaobject you want.

> 💡 **Tip:** There is a faster way to add a metaobject: instead of going through **Settings**, use the **Add** button in the top-right corner of this page.

![After saving, go back to the home page, click on Content and stay in Metaobjects. Choose the metaobject you want.](../../screenshots/2-filters/5-after-saving-and-coming-back-to-home-page-click-on-content-and-stay-in-metaobjects-then-choose-a-metaobject-and-btw-there-is-also-a-faster-way-to-add-a-metaobject-instead-of-going-through-the-settings-there-is-an-add-button-on-top-right.png)

**Step 6:** After choosing the metaobject, click on the top-right button to add an entry.

![After choosing the metaobject, click on the top-right button to add an entry.](../../screenshots/2-filters/6-after-choosing-the-metafield-to-add-an-entry-click-on-top-right-button.png)

### Register the filter in Search & Discovery

> **Note:** Only follow the steps in this section if the metaobject hasn't been added as a filter yet.

**Step 7:** After saving, click on **Search & Discovery**.

![After saving, click on Search & Discovery.](../../screenshots/2-filters/7-after-saving-click-on-search-and-discovery-but-only-if-the-metaobject-has-not-been-added-as-a-filter-yet.png)

**Step 8:** Click on **Filters**.

![Click on Filters.](../../screenshots/2-filters/8-click-on-filters.png)

**Step 9:** Click on **Add filter**.

![Click on Add filter.](../../screenshots/2-filters/9-click-on-add-filter.png)

**Step 10:** Click on **Select source**.

![Click on Select source.](../../screenshots/2-filters/10-click-on-select-source.png)

**Step 11:** Give the filter the same name as the metafield (for example source *Volume* → filter label *Volume*).

![Give the filter the same name as the metafield (for example source Volume → filter label Volume).](../../screenshots/2-filters/11-name-the-filter-the-same-way-as-the-metafield.png)

### Add a collection

To add a collection, you first add an entry to the **Collections** metaobject. Then you create the collection itself.

**Step 12:** Open the **Collections** metaobject.

![Open the Collections metaobject.](../../screenshots/2-filters/12-to-add-a-collection-you-first-need-to-add-an-entry-inside-collections-metaobject.png)

**Step 13:** Click on **Add entry**.

![Click on Add entry.](../../screenshots/2-filters/13-click-on-add-entry.png)

**Step 14:** Enter the name of the new collection, then save.

![Enter the name of the new collection, then save.](../../screenshots/2-filters/14-add-a-new-collection-name-then-save.png)

**Step 15:** Click on **Products**.

![Click on Products.](../../screenshots/2-filters/15-now-click-on-products.png)

**Step 16:** Click on **Collections**.

![Click on Collections.](../../screenshots/2-filters/16-click-on-collections.png)

**Step 17:** Click on **Add collection**.

![Click on Add collection.](../../screenshots/2-filters/17-click-on-add-collection.png)

**Step 18:** Click on **Add condition**.

![Click on Add condition.](../../screenshots/2-filters/18-click-on-add-condition.png)

**Step 19:** Click on **Metafield**.

![Click on Metafield.](../../screenshots/2-filters/19-click-on-metafield.png)

**Step 20:** Click on **Collections**.

![Click on Collections.](../../screenshots/2-filters/20-click-on-collections.png)

**Step 21:** Select the new collection. Give the collection the same title, then add the description and the image. Save.

![Select the new collection. Give the collection the same title, then add the description and the image. Save.](../../screenshots/2-filters/21-select-the-new-collection-then-add-the-same-name-to%20the-title-then-add-the-description-and-the-image-then-save.png)

### Add a product

**Step 22:** Go to **Products**.

![Go to Products.](../../screenshots/2-filters/22-go-to-products.png)

**Step 23:** Click on **Add product**.

![Click on Add product.](../../screenshots/2-filters/23-add-a-product.png)

**Step 24:** Fill in all the fields except **Type** and **Tags**.

> ⚠️ **Warning:** Never click on **Add collections** in this part of the form. Collections are assigned further down.

![Fill in all the fields except Type and Tags.](../../screenshots/2-filters/24-fill-all-the%20fields-besides-type-and-tags-and-NO-MATTER-WHAT-NEVER-CLICK-ON%20ADD-COLLECTIONS.png)

**Step 25:** Continue filling in the fields.

![Continue filling in the fields.](../../screenshots/2-filters/25-continue-entering-the-fields.png)

**Step 26:** Add or change the product's collections here, and only here.

![Add or change the product's collections here, and only here.](../../screenshots/2-filters/26-only-here-can-you-modify-the-add-the-collections.png)

**Step 27:** After adding the collections, choose the primary collection.

![After adding the collections, choose the primary collection.](../../screenshots/2-filters/27-then-after-adding-the-collections-you-must-choose-the-primary-collection.png)

**Step 28:** The primary collection is shown in the product page's breadcrumb.

![The primary collection is shown in the product page's breadcrumb.](../../screenshots/2-filters/28-the-primary-collection-will-be-used-in-the-breadcrumb.png)

**Step 29:** Fill in the remaining fields and save.

![Fill in the remaining fields and save.](../../screenshots/2-filters/29-finish-the-entering-remaining-fields.png)
